span.p:
New user starts with no tier.
First purchase triggers tier assignment.
member_status table tracks:
- current_tier
- capsule_count_current_year
- tier_achieved_at
- next_review_date

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Annual review process:
1. Count capsules purchased in past year
2. Compare against tier thresholds
3. Update tier if changed
4. Log change in member_status_history
5. Notify user of new tier/benefits
